Legend

The source image, cut and placed over each orthographic view.

How it was built

Input: one PNG (300 dpi, 9934 × 14042 px) rendered from the GA sheet. Nothing else was read.

Scale: 74 frame-ruler ticks detected in the pixels, 81.20 px per 500 mm frame (6.16 mm per pixel). Baselines and centrelines found as long horizontal and vertical pixel runs; the draught marks at 2.613 and 2.787 m confirm the scale.

Hull: keel, skeg and stem traced in the inboard profile; waterlines traced in the plans; Fr. 17 contour traced; duct circles fitted to pixels in the view from aft. Superstructure sizes measured by pixel projections.

The overlay is the image itself, cut to each view.
